items.title: Arca Opens to Everyone, Paying People for the AI Sessions They'd Otherwise Throw Away
items.summary: After invite-only early access, the desktop app from the team behind Brevis is now open to anyone on Mac and Windows. HONG KONG, November 11, 2026: Arca, a new desktop app from the team behind Brevis, opened to the public today. Arca pays people for the AI sessions they’d otherwise throw away. It finds the session history their AI tools already keep on their computer, lets them choose which sessions to submit, strips sensitive details on the device before anything is uploaded, and pays for the sessions that are approved.
